title: echarts
author: Allan CORNET
summary: Interactive Apache ECharts charts for Nelson: 30+ chart types (bar, line, area, scatter, pie, radar, heatmap, calendar, boxplot, candlestick, sankey, graph, tree, treemap, sunburst, funnel, gauge, parallel, themeRiver, choropleth map, wordcloud, ...), offline rendering, HTML/PNG/SVG export, zoom, data labels, mark lines and click callbacks.
description: Interactive charts for Nelson powered by Apache ECharts: a faithful, object-oriented binding that renders live charts in the WebView/WebAssembly desktop and exports self-contained HTML everywhere else.
